settings.visualStyle: Grounded World War II frontline historical reenactment, Poland September 1939, 35mm wartime field-film aesthetic, slightly faded low-saturation color, restrained film grain, practical smoke and dust, natural overcast-to-afternoon light, handheld camera operated by a war correspondent close to the infantry. Period-correct uniforms, rifles, trucks, light armored vehicles, village architecture and field equipment. Non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game-like framing, no heroic glamour.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds, approximately 120 seconds. Third-person / embedded-cameraman frontline footage rather than first-person shooter POV. One primary action and one dominant camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narrator and no intelligible commands. Tell the episode using marching, battlefield movement, visual reactions, environmental sound, gunfire, engines, wind, mud, debris and brief human recovery beats. Preserve uniform, mud, smoke, daylight and equipment continuity from the previous scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: 1939 European frontline field-film look: shoulder-height handheld photography, imperfect focus pulls, modest gate weave, realistic motion blur, muted greens/browns/greys, wet roads, autumn fields, smoke-stained plaster and restrained explosions. Do not simulate damaged archival film so heavily that faces or actions become unreadable.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional composite frontline rifleman serves only as a continuity anchor inside a real 1939 Polish campaign environment. The story does not claim to recreate one documented platoon or exact camera reel.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute historical war-film episode set during the 1939 invasion of Poland. Follow one fictional composite frontline rifleman and his nearby infantry section from a muddy dawn road march, through the first sight of smoke, cautious deployment into fields, first contact at a village edge, a brief street fight, a field flanking movement, light armored support, a quiet aftermath beat, and the column moving onward toward a smoke-filled horizon. The emotional progression is uncertainty → first shock → focused movement → brief intensity → fatigue → realization that the war is only beginning. Keep all violence non-graphic. Do not show celebratory propaganda or triumphant posing. No dialogue or narration. The visual language should feel like a 1939 embedded field camera, not modern action cinema and not a video game.
movie.storySummary: In September 1939, a fictional infantry rifleman marches with his section along a muddy Polish country road. Smoke ahead forces the column to leave the road and deploy into wet fields. First contact at a village edge turns into a short, confusing fight through walls, lanes and hedges. Light armored vehicles move up as the immediate resistance fades. The rifleman passes a wounded comrade, reforms with the column, and continues toward multiple smoke columns on the horizon. The episode ends without victory language: one village is behind them, but the wider war has only begun.
movie.genreDetailPrompt: Historical reenactment clearly framed as generated cinematic reconstruction rather than genuine archival footage.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP01 — Poland 1939: The War Begins

scenes.title: Mud Road at Dawn
scenes.description: A long infantry column moves through pale dawn mist on a muddy country road bordered by autumn fields and telegraph poles.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks at a steady pace with the section, adjusting one shoulder strap while trucks crawl behind the marching column.
scenes.imageDescription: Vertical 9:16 embedded war-correspondent frame, September 1939 Polish countryside at dawn, muddy unpaved road with wagon ruts, wet grass, telegraph poles fading into mist, early-war infantry in historically plausible field uniforms and steel helmets, the same fictional rifleman mid-column with rifle carried low at the shoulder, military trucks behind, no combat yet, subdued 35mm field-film color, realistic grain and moisture on boots.
scenes.videoPrompt: Walk beside the infantry at shoulder height with mild handheld bounce, letting boots and muddy ruts fill the lower frame before drifting up to the rifleman. Audio: synchronized boots in mud, leather and metal gear creaks, idling truck engines, faint wind, distant aircraft hum, no speech, no music for the first seconds.
scenes.audioDirection: Foreground boots and gear; mid-ground engines; background wind and distant aircraft. No intelligible voices.

scenes.title: Smoke Beyond the Fields
scenes.description: The column slows when a dark smoke column becomes visible above a distant village.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stops and turns his head toward the smoke while men behind him compress the marching formation and wait.
scenes.imageDescription: Same rifleman, same uniform and mud level, stopped on the same country road; autumn field opens toward a low Polish village with a single dark smoke plume, soldiers study the horizon, trucks idle behind them, morning haze beginning to thin, restrained wartime-film color and grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start close on boots stopping in mud, tilt to the rifleman, then make one slow pan across the field to the distant smoke. Audio: boots stop, engines idle, light wind through grass, faint distant rumble, no intelligible speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Let the sound become quieter than Scene 1 to create anticipation.

scenes.title: Off the Road
scenes.description: The section leaves the road and spreads along a wet hedgerow before approaching the village.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman ducks through tall wet grass beside a hedge as nearby soldiers widen their spacing.
scenes.imageDescription: Wet autumn grass, dark hedge roots, shallow drainage ditch, infantry moving away from the road in a loose line, same lead rifleman with damp trousers and muddy boots, village roofs partly visible ahead through light haze, historically plausible 1939 rifles and web gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Use one low lateral tracking move through wet grass, briefly letting leaves obscure the lens before revealing the rifleman advancing behind the hedge. Audio: grass brushing fabric, mud suction, gear rattle, one very distant gunshot, no speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Environmental detail dominates; combat remains distant.

scenes.title: First Contact
scenes.description: Rifle fire cracks from beyond the village edge and the section dives behind a low stone wall.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman drops hard behind a damp stone wall while two nearby soldiers flatten beside him and fragments of plaster flick from a building corner ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Village-edge stone wall, whitewashed house with dark tiled roof, drifting smoke, wet road, same rifleman suddenly low behind cover, no visible blood, chips of plaster and dust indicating incoming fire, authentic early-war equipment, handheld documentary framing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Begin at standing shoulder height, then make one abrupt human-operated drop behind the wall as nearby impacts chip masonry. Do not center the rifle. Audio: sharp rifle cracks, stone chips, hard breathing, distant engine, no shouted words.
scenes.audioDirection: First major loudness spike of the episode. Keep voices nonverbal and indistinct.

scenes.title: Answer From the Wall
scenes.description: The section begins returning controlled fire toward an unseen opposing position farther down the village lane.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman rises just enough above the wall to fire several controlled shots, then lowers again while another soldier watches the lane.
scenes.imageDescription: Same damp stone wall and village edge, rifleman partially exposed with rifle offset from center, light muzzle smoke, tiled roofs and narrow lane ahead, smoke drifting left to right, realistic recoil posture, no visible enemy required, non-graphic battlefield reconstruction.
scenes.videoPrompt: One restrained over-shoulder handheld composition; the rifleman rises, fires controlled shots, then drops back behind cover. Audio: three to four rifle reports, echoes between houses, brass and gear sounds, distant answering fire, no speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Keep shots discrete rather than continuous automatic fire.

scenes.title: Across the Lane
scenes.description: The section crosses a short exposed village lane to reach the protection of a damaged house.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman makes one short run across wet cobblestones and presses against a smoke-stained plaster wall beside the rest of his section.
scenes.imageDescription: Narrow Polish village lane, wet cobblestones, damaged plaster, wooden gate, broken cart near curb, smoke-stained houses, same rifleman sprinting with rifle held low, nearby soldiers reaching the same wall, no graphic injuries.
scenes.videoPrompt: Follow behind the rifleman in one short handheld dash across the lane and stop hard at the wall. Audio: boots slapping wet stones, gear bounce, two distant cracks, falling plaster, breathing. No speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Brief high-energy movement, then immediate compression of sound at cover.

scenes.title: Pinned in the Courtyard
scenes.description: A burst of fire halts movement inside a small courtyard as a nearby support team prepares its weapon.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crouches behind stacked timber while a two-man support team sets up nearby; nobody advances during this beat.
scenes.imageDescription: Small farm courtyard opening off the street, stacked timber, low stone trough, smoke haze, same rifleman crouched and breathing, period support weapon being prepared by nearby infantry, restrained tension, historically grounded equipment, no enemy visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still embedded-camera shot from behind timber with a small nervous reframe toward the support team. Audio: intermittent incoming fire, wood splinters, metallic setup sounds, breathing; no intelligible commands.
scenes.audioDirection: Use gaps between gunshots so tension comes from waiting.

scenes.title: Flank Through the Grass
scenes.description: A small group leaves the courtyard and crawls along a field-side hedge to bypass the blocked lane.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crawls through wet grass beside a shallow ditch, using the hedge to remain below the village sightline.
scenes.imageDescription: Return to same hedgerow environment but now dirtier and smokier, rifleman prone in wet grass, sleeves damp and knees muddy, two soldiers spaced behind, village roofline partly concealed by hedge, rifle carried close to body.
scenes.videoPrompt: Ground-level lateral crawl shot through blades of wet grass, ending as the rifleman reaches the ditch. Audio: grass, wet soil, fabric friction, distant fire muffled by terrain, no speech.

scenes.title: Fire Across the Ditch
scenes.description: The flanking group fires from the shallow ditch toward an opposing position beyond the field.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman rises onto one elbow and fires from the ditch lip while earth flicks up farther across the field.
scenes.imageDescription: Shallow muddy drainage ditch, autumn field, low smoke drifting across stubble, same rifleman firing from prone, nearby friendly rifleman offset behind, opposing force remains distant and spatially separate, non-graphic combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder shot from ditch level, one short firing sequence followed by the rifleman lowering his head. Audio: controlled rifle shots, wind, distant answering fire, soil impacts farther away. No speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Strong but brief combat beat; do not turn into continuous gunfire.

scenes.title: Armor Moves Up
scenes.description: Light armored vehicles rumble past the infantry toward the village after the immediate fire slackens.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman returns to the road edge and watches period light armor pass through mud toward the village.
scenes.imageDescription: Same countryside road later in the morning, deeper ruts and more mud, tired infantry standing aside, historically plausible early-war light armored vehicles moving toward smoke, lead rifleman with dirtier uniform watching them pass, no triumph pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: One side pan following the vehicles as they pass from foreground toward the village, keeping the rifleman at the edge of frame. Audio: engines, tracks, mud, gear, battle now more distant. No speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Mechanical sound replaces gunfire as the dominant layer.

scenes.title: Quiet Street
scenes.description: The same village lane is now quieter, filled with smoke, broken glass and tired infantry moving carefully forward.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks slowly through the lane, stepping around debris while checking windows and doorways.
scenes.imageDescription: Same village architecture as earlier, smoke thinner, cracked plaster, broken glass, damaged cart, rifleman walking cautiously with weapon lowered but ready, several exhausted comrades behind, no civilians shown, no graphic casualties.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow shoulder-height walking shot a few meters behind the rifleman, with one gentle focus shift from rubble foreground to his silhouette. Audio: boots on glass and stones, small fires, distant artillery, wind. No speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Reduce combat volume significantly to create emotional space.

scenes.title: A Wounded Comrade
scenes.description: Two soldiers help an injured comrade away from the street as the rifleman pauses for a moment.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman lowers his rifle slightly and watches two comrades support a conscious wounded soldier past him.
scenes.imageDescription: Non-graphic aftermath in the village, conscious wounded soldier supported under both arms, no visible open wounds, rifleman standing aside with exhausted expression, smoke and damaged walls in background, historically grounded uniforms.
scenes.videoPrompt: Use a gentle push-in from the rifleman to the passing trio, then stop. Audio: strained breathing, slow boots, cloth and gear, distant guns; no intelligible speech or crying.

scenes.title: Reform the Column
scenes.description: The section gathers beside the muddy road, checks gear and prepares to move again.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman tightens his pack strap, wipes mud from one hand and falls back into the marching line.
scenes.imageDescription: Late-morning roadside regrouping, same muddy road, rifleman noticeably dirtier than Scene 1, troops checking packs and rifles, smoke from village behind, vehicles farther ahead, muted wartime color.
scenes.videoPrompt: Begin close on muddy hand tightening a strap, then pull back as the rifleman steps into line. Audio: fabric, metal buckle, boots restarting, engines farther ahead. No speech.
scenes.audioDirection: Quiet transition beat with marching rhythm returning.

scenes.title: More Smoke on the Horizon
scenes.description: From a low rise, the rifleman sees several smoke columns scattered across the distant countryside.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stops on the field edge and looks toward multiple distant smoke columns before turning back toward the road.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide vertical landscape from low autumn rise, hedges and farmland leading to several distant smoke columns, same tired rifleman foreground profile, muddy uniform and rifle carried low, no active firing nearby, subdued afternoon light.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow panoramic reveal from the rifleman to the wide smoke-marked horizon, then hold. Audio: wind over grass, faint engines, very distant artillery, no close gunfire and no speech.

scenes.title: The War Has Begun
scenes.description: The column disappears along the road toward the next horizon as the smoke behind and ahead remains visible.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman continues walking with the column until he becomes one small figure among many moving away from the camera.
scenes.imageDescription: Long muddy Polish road receding into late-day haze, infantry column walking away, lead rifleman recognizable by same gear and silhouette but now small in frame, smoke columns across distant countryside, no victory gesture, 1939 field-film aesthetic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Hold a long rear field-camera shot as the marching column gradually recedes; allow slight imperfect handheld drift rather than a polished dolly. Audio: diminishing boots, engines, wind, distant artillery. End without dialogue or triumphant music.
scenes.audioDirection: Resolve with environmental sound only or a very low restrained score tail.

characters.name: Frontline Rifleman
characters.description: Anonymous young adult European infantry rifleman represented as a fictional composite, not a named historical person. Lean-average build, weathered face, short hair under a period steel helmet, early-war field uniform, leather boots, ammunition pouches, field pack and period rifle.
characters.mainOutfit: 1939 period-correct field uniform, steel helmet, leather boots, web/leather field gear and rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep the same face, helmet, uniform cut, rifle, pack and pouch layout through all scenes. Mud begins light in Scenes 1–3, becomes heavier after field and village combat, and stays visible through Scene 15. No random costume changes or cross-faction equipment.
